_comment: Shape of tasks.json. One entry per work package, matching schemas/work-package.schema.json. This example is a reference for the plan coordinator, not a fixture.

tasks.objective: Add a per-client sliding-window rate limiter to the public API middleware so that a client exceeding the configured budget receives HTTP 429.
tasks.interfaces: check_rate_limit(client_id: str, now: float) -> RateLimitDecision, where RateLimitDecision exposes .allowed: bool and .retry_after: float | None. Middleware returns 429 with a Retry-After header when .allowed is False.
tasks.constraints: No new third-party dependencies. Reuse the existing Redis client from src/cache.py; do not open a second connection pool. Follow the project's existing middleware registration pattern.

verification.method: pytest, including a test that fails before the change
verification.expected: All tests pass. test_exceeds_budget_returns_429 must fail before the implementation exists.
